# ANS-SITI

> Anantashilpa Sustainable Infratech Innovations Pvt. Ltd. (ANS–SITI) develops sustainable construction materials, 3D concrete printing and circular infrastructure solutions at IIT Dharwad, Karnataka, India.

ANS-SITI is the company name. Its official website is https://www.ans-siti.com/.
The website describes the company's construction technology focus, team, research, product photographs and contact information. The company is based on the IIT Dharwad campus; it is not the IIT Dharwad institute website.

## Company and contact

- Legal name: Anantashilpa Sustainable Infratech Innovations Pvt. Ltd.
- Common names: ANS-SITI, ANS–SITI, ANS SITI.
- Email: info@ans-siti.com
- Telephone: +91 90711 80989
- Address: #1, 305, Third Floor, Admin Block, IIT Dharwad Campus, Dharwad, Karnataka 580011, India.

## Official pages

- [Home](https://www.ans-siti.com/): Company overview and sustainable construction focus.
- [About and leadership](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/about.html): Leadership profiles.
- [Construction technology focus areas](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/services.html): Sustainable construction materials, 3D concrete printing, circular economy and digital fabrication.
- [3D-printed concrete benches](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/products.html): Arch, triangular and patterned bench designs with product photographs.
- [Projects](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/projects.html): Printed concrete bench work and links to the gallery.
- [Research and innovation](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/research.html): Printable materials, recycled construction resources and low-carbon infrastructure research.
- [News](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/news.html): Company updates and launch information.
- [Contact](https://www.ans-siti.com/pages/contact.html): Contact details and enquiry form.
